sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A perennial orchid of Europe and Asia, 25–80 cm tall. It grows in open pine woods and nutrient-poor grassland, often on calcareous soils.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The leaves are arranged in two rows along the stem. The one-sided raceme bears reddish-brown to purple flowers that may smell of vanilla. The fruit is a capsule.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is documented in the sources consulted.
